problem.subject: Label printer prints blank labels after ribbon change
problem.description: Since we swapped the ribbon on Monday the label printer at reception feeds labels but they come out completely blank. We have tried two new ribbons.

steps_taken: Reloaded the ribbon, ink side confirmed facing the media. Labels still blank.
Ran media calibration and a factory reset. Print head self-test fails with code H-07.

prior_cases.subject: Label printer prints faint labels
prior_cases.description: The label printer at reception prints labels so faint the sterilisation pouch barcodes will not scan. It has got worse over about two weeks.
prior_cases.resolution: Print head was dirty. Cleaned the head with an isopropyl swab and raised darkness to 12.

prior_cases.subject: Label printer offline after power cut
prior_cases.description: After the power cut on Saturday the label printer shows offline on both reception PCs.
prior_cases.resolution: Printer came back on a new IP address. Reserved the address on the router and re-pointed the print queue.
